title: 混合整数目标规划实现个性化膳食优化
summary: 提出混合整数目标规划（MIGP）解决膳食优化中连续变量导致分数份量（如1.7个鸡蛋）和硬约束导致不可行的问题。使用整数变量实现实际份量，目标规划偏差实现软营养目标，逆目标归一化平衡多营养优化。在810个实例中，MIGP在66%情况下优于后取整方法，100%可行，求解时间低于100毫秒。
summary_en: Proposes Mixed Integer Goal Programming (MIGP) for personalized meal optimization, addressing impractical fractional servings and infeasibility from hard constraints. Uses integer variables for practical serving counts and goal programming deviations for soft targets. Outperforms rounding-based methods in 66% of 810 instances with 100% feasibility and sub-100ms solve times.
